title: CapabilityBinding
description: Connects a Capability, in a given CapabilityScope, to exactly the CapabilityProvider and EngineInstance that serves it -- when the binding wins deterministic resolution (resolution.schema.json). A binding never itself grants entitlement; entitlement is CapabilityGrant's responsibility.

engine_instance_id.description: Concrete runtime deployment. binding.provider_id's engine_key must equal this engine instance's engine_key; validated by the Control Plane before activation, not by this schema alone.

priority.description: Explicit ordered priority used only after scope specificity is compared (see scope-specificity.yaml). Never a substitute for specificity.

configuration.description: Binding-level provider configuration overrides (e.g. sales_channel_id, warehouse_reference). Never a place for secret values -- reference them instead.
